replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

AutoSneak is a client side modifaction that allows you to sneak whilst crafting, having your inventory open etc.
NoSlowDown is a client side modifaction that allows you to eat whilst sprinting, pull your bow back whilst sprinting etc.
